general.title: General
general.description: Workspace name, currency and regional formats.
general.currencyHelp: ISO 4217 code used for new currency fields and reports.
general.staleDealDaysHelp: Open deals without activity for this long are flagged as stale.
general.timezoneHelp: Used for due dates and scheduled automations. This browser: {{tz}}.

backendHelp.local: Data stays in this browser's IndexedDB (single user).
backendHelp.journal: Encrypted snapshot + journal on your own storage.
backendHelp.git-json: One JSON file per document, one commit per change.

dataModel.title: Data model
dataModel.description: Objects and fields of your CRM. Standard objects can be extended; custom objects are yours.
dataModel.noCustomHelp: Create objects for anything you track: projects, tickets, contracts…
dataModel.labelFieldHelp: Shown as the record's name in lists, relations and search.
dataModel.newObjectHelp: The object starts with a Name field; add more fields next.
dataModel.deleteObjectConfirm_one: Its {{count}} record, its views and every relation field pointing to it will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
dataModel.deleteObjectConfirm_other: Its {{count}} records, its views and every relation field pointing to it will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.

fields.label: Label
fields.typeLocked: The type of this field can't change.
fields.systemHelp: System field: it can be renamed but not retyped or deleted.
fields.standardHelp: Standard field: hide it instead of deleting it.
fields.managedHelp: The options of this field mirror the pipeline stages. Edit them in Settings → Pipelines.
fields.inverseFieldHelp: Name of the list shown on {{object}}.
fields.relationLocked: The target and cardinality of a relation can't change after creation.
fields.optionsFromValues: Leave empty to build the options from the existing values.
fields.reorderHelp: Drag the handles to reorder fields (keyboard: focus a handle, Space, arrows, Space).
fields.typeChangeWarning_one: Changing the type converts the {{count}} existing value from {{from}} to {{to}}. Values that can't be converted are cleared.
fields.typeChangeWarning_other: Changing the type converts the {{count}} existing values from {{from}} to {{to}}. Values that can't be converted are cleared.
fields.typeChangeConfirm_one: {{count}} record has a value for this field. It will be converted; values that can't be converted are cleared. This can't be undone.
fields.typeChangeConfirm_other: {{count}} records have a value for this field. They will be converted; values that can't be converted are cleared. This can't be undone.
fields.deleteConfirm_one: {{count}} record has a value for this field. The values and the field are removed from every view. This can't be undone.
fields.deleteConfirm_other: {{count}} records have a value for this field. The values and the field are removed from every view. This can't be undone.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.description: Stages your deals move through, with their win probability.
pipelines.noObjectHelp: Pipelines need an object with a "stage" select field (like Deals).
pipelines.name: Pipeline name
pipelines.removedStages_one: Removed: {{stages}}. {{count}} record is on these stages.
pipelines.removedStages_other: Removed: {{stages}}. {{count}} records are on these stages.
pipelines.deleteHelp: Records of this pipeline move to the first stage of another pipeline.

users.title: Users & roles
users.description: Who can see and change the CRM.
users.addHelp: On account backends (Firebase, git) the person signs in with this email; elsewhere users are owners and assignees.
users.name: Name
users.deleteHelp: Records owned by this user and tasks assigned to them are reassigned.

roleHelp.admin: Everything, including data model, settings, users and purges.
roleHelp.member: Create, edit and delete records, activities, own views; import and export.
roleHelp.viewer: Read-only access to records, activities and reports.

backendNote.default: Users are the people records can be owned by and tasks assigned to.
backendNote.local: This browser has a single signed-in identity; other users are owners and assignees only.
backendNote.journal: Encrypted files have no accounts: users are owners and assignees, the passphrase grants access.
backendNote.firebase: Firebase accounts map to these users by email; roles are enforced by the Firestore rules.
backendNote.git-json: Git users map by email; repository permissions limit what each person can write.

import.title: Import
import.description: Bring records in from a CSV file (HubSpot, Pipedrive, spreadsheets…).
import.pasteHelp: First line = column headers. Comma, semicolon or tab separated.
import.emptyCsv: No header or row found in this CSV.
import.duplicateTargets: Several columns map to the same field.
import.onDuplicateHelp: People match by email, companies by domain, others by name.
import.dryRunNote: Dry run: nothing was written yet. Review the report, then import.

export.title: Export & backup
export.description: Download your data as CSV or a full JSON backup — it's yours.
export.includeId: Include the ID column (re-import updates by ID)
export.jsonHelp: Every object, record, activity, pipeline, view, automation, form, user and setting in one file. Secrets are never included.
export.restoreHelp: Load a JSON backup made by AgentCRM. Merge upserts every document; replace also deletes what's not in the backup.
export.notAnExport: This file is not an AgentCRM JSON export.
export.restoreMergeWarning: Every document of the backup overwrites the current version with the same id.
export.restoreReplaceWarning: The CRM will match the backup exactly: everything created since is permanently deleted.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.adminOnly: Only admins can run maintenance operations.
danger.compactHelp: Permanently erases items deleted more than {{days}} days ago and rewrites the storage without history.
danger.compactConfirm: {{records}} records, {{activities}} activities and {{runs}} automation runs will be erased for good. This can't be undone.
danger.purgeHelp: Physically erases every soft-deleted record and activity (GDPR erasure).
danger.demoHelp: Adds sample companies, people, deals and activities to explore the CRM.
danger.demoConfirm: Sample records are added next to your data (nothing is deleted). Remove them later by hand.
danger.demoLoaded: Demo data loaded: {{companies}} companies, {{people}} people, {{deals}} deals
